questions.stem: 下列哪种变化是把液态水变成水蒸气？

data.user_input: At standard atmospheric pressure, pure water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius and boils at 100 degrees Celsius. Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen, and its chemical formula is H2O. Each water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. Ice is solid water, liquid water flows, and water vapor is gaseous water. Melting changes solid ice to liquid water. Freezing changes liquid water to ice. Evaporation changes liquid water to vapor. Condensation changes vapor to liquid water. These changes of state do not change the chemical composition of water. Please make questions only about this text.
